module.title: Stylish Relationship Tracker
module.description: A system-agnostic social link / relationship archive for FoundryVTT.

allowObserverView.name: Allow Observer View-Only Access
allowObserverView.hint: Let players with OBSERVER permission on an Actor open that Actor's Relationship Tracker without granting editing access. Player-visible records are shown; owner-only and GM-only records remain hidden.

allowPlayerEdit.name: Allow Player Relationship Editing
allowPlayerEdit.hint: Master switch for player relationship editing. Role, Actor permission, and the field-category settings below determine exactly what each eligible player may change.

playerEditMinimumRole.name: Minimum User Role for Player Editing
playerEditMinimumRole.hint: When player relationship editing is enabled, choose the minimum user role required to edit relationships.

playerEditMinimumPermission.name: Minimum Actor Permission for Player Editing
playerEditMinimumPermission.hint: When player relationship editing is enabled, choose the minimum Actor permission required to edit relationships.

playerEditStructure.name: Player Editing: Relationship Structure
playerEditStructure.hint: Allow eligible players to create and delete relationships, switch between Custom and Linked Actor entries, and link or unlink observable target Actors. Keep this disabled when players should only edit fields on existing relationships. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditBasic.name: Player Editing: Basic Information
playerEditBasic.hint: Allow eligible players to edit relationship names, roles, romanized names, and biographies. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditType.name: Player Editing: Relationship Type
playerEditType.hint: Allow eligible players to edit relationship class codes and type/category labels. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditRank.name: Player Editing: Rank Values
playerEditRank.hint: Allow eligible players to directly edit current rank, maximum rank, steps per rank, and rank progress in the Manager. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerUseRankControls.name: Player Editing: Rank +/- Controls
playerUseRankControls.hint: Allow eligible players to use rank increase and decrease controls on relationship screens, the map, and the Quick Panel. This is separate from directly editing rank values in the Manager.

playerEditAppearance.name: Player Editing: Appearance and Images
playerEditAppearance.hint: Allow eligible players to edit accent colors, portraits, list images, thumbnails, image transforms, and cut-in artwork. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditStats.name: Player Editing: Stat Cards
playerEditStats.hint: Allow eligible players to edit the three Stat Cards shown in the relationship archive. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditNotes.name: Player Editing: Notes
playerEditNotes.hint: Allow eligible players to add, edit, and delete player-visible relationship notes. GM-only notes remain protected. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

playerEditEvents.name: Player Editing: Event Log
playerEditEvents.hint: Allow eligible players to add, edit, delete, and reorder relationship events. Requires Allow Player Relationship Editing.

showLocked.name: Show Locked Relationships to Players
showLocked.hint: When enabled, locked relationships appear to players as redacted entries with minimal type information. When disabled, locked relationships are hidden from player views.

allowPlayerGiveGifts.name: Allow Players to Give Gifts
allowPlayerGiveGifts.hint: Allow players to give eligible embedded Items from Actors they own. Gift outcomes and inventory consumption are still resolved authoritatively by the active GM.

requireGmGiftApproval.name: Require GM Approval for Player Gifts
requireGmGiftApproval.hint: When enabled, a player's Gift request enters the active GM's approval queue. Nothing is consumed or changed until the GM approves it. GM Gifts remain immediate.

giftItemTypeFilter.name: Use Custom Gift Item Type Filter
giftItemTypeFilter.hint: Limit Gift pickers to the selected Item document types. When disabled, all types are accepted unless this system has a built-in safety preset.

giftDefaultConsumeMode.name: Default Gift Consumption
giftDefaultConsumeMode.hint: Choose whether new Gift Profiles consume the given Item by default.

giftDefaultMaxQuantityPerGift.name: Default Maximum Gift Quantity
giftDefaultMaxQuantityPerGift.hint: Maximum quantity that a new Gift Profile allows in one Gift action.

giftDefaultUnmatchedGiftMode.name: Default Unmatched Gift Handling
giftDefaultUnmatchedGiftMode.hint: Choose what new Gift Profiles do when an Item matches no preference rule.

giftDefaultUnmatchedGiftProgressDelta.name: Default Unmatched Gift Progress
giftDefaultUnmatchedGiftProgressDelta.hint: Progress granted by an unmatched Gift when the neutral handling mode is used.

giftDefaultPreferenceVisibility.name: Default Gift Preference Visibility
giftDefaultPreferenceVisibility.hint: Choose how much preference information new Gift Profiles reveal before a Gift is given.

giftDefaultAllowMaxRankGifts.name: Allow Gifts at Maximum Rank by Default
giftDefaultAllowMaxRankGifts.hint: Allow new Gift Profiles to accept Gifts after the relationship reaches its maximum rank.

giftDefaultRejectedConsumeMode.name: Default Rejected Gift Consumption
giftDefaultRejectedConsumeMode.hint: Choose whether a rejected Gift is consumed in newly created Gift Profiles.

giftDefaultReactionAudience.name: Default Gift Reaction Audience
giftDefaultReactionAudience.hint: Choose who receives Gift reaction cut-ins from new Gift Profiles.

giftDefaultReactionDisplayMode.name: Default Gift Reaction Display
giftDefaultReactionDisplayMode.hint: Choose how new Gift Profiles present their reaction.

soundVolume.name: Relationship SFX Volume
soundVolume.hint: Controls the volume of relationship archive button and rank cut-in sound effects.

soundEnabled.name: Enable Relationship SFX
soundEnabled.hint: Play sound effects when using the relationship archive and rank cut-ins.

hostileAccentEnabled.name: Change Colors for Hostile Relationships
hostileAccentEnabled.hint: When enabled, hostile relationships use the world hostile accent color. When disabled, they keep each relationship's existing accent color.

hostileAccentColor.name: Hostile Relationship Accent
hostileAccentColor.hint: Color used for hostile relationship cards, ranks, progress, and controls throughout this world.

worldDisplayProfileEnabled.name: Use One World Display Profile
worldDisplayProfileEnabled.hint: Override every Actor's visual tracker profile with the settings below. Actor-specific values are kept and return when this is disabled.

worldProfileTheme.name: World Tracker Theme
worldProfileTheme.hint: Theme used by every Actor while the world display profile is enabled.

worldProfileTitle.name: World Tracker Title
worldProfileTitle.hint: Main title shown in the tracker header.

worldProfileSubtitle.name: World Tracker Subtitle
worldProfileSubtitle.hint: Subtitle shown beside or below the main tracker title.

worldProfileLozenge.name: World Header Mark
worldProfileLozenge.hint: Short mark shown in supported theme headers, up to three characters.

worldProfileArchiveLabel.name: World Archive Label
worldProfileArchiveLabel.hint: Secondary archive label shown in tracker headers.

worldProfileBondLabel.name: World Relationship Term (Singular)
worldProfileBondLabel.hint: Singular term used for character relationships throughout the tracker.

worldProfileBondLabelPlural.name: World Relationship Term (Plural)
worldProfileBondLabelPlural.hint: Plural term used for character relationship lists and labels.

worldProfileFontScale.name: World Font Scale
worldProfileFontScale.hint: Text scale applied across every relationship theme.

worldProfileShowBgLetter.name: Show Background Letter (Archive)
worldProfileShowBgLetter.hint: Show the decorative background letter in the Archive theme.

worldProfileShowNameRoman.name: Show Romanized Name (Archive)
worldProfileShowNameRoman.hint: Show romanized relationship names in the Archive theme.

worldProfileMapUseThumbnails.name: Use Relationship Map Thumbnails
worldProfileMapUseThumbnails.hint: Prefer generated map thumbnails over full portraits for relationship nodes.

themeFontOverrides.name: Theme Font Overrides
themeFontOverrides.hint: Replace each font family used by a theme with another font loaded in Foundry. Changes also apply to relationship maps, Rank cut-ins, Gift reactions, and Gift approval screens.

rankUp.name: Rank Up Message
rankUp.hint: Main message for this theme's Rank Up cut-in and Gift results that increase a rank. Leave blank to use the built-in text.

rankDown.name: Rank Down Message
rankDown.hint: Main message for this theme's Rank Down cut-in. Leave blank to use the built-in text.

max.name: Max Rank Message
max.hint: Main message for this theme's Max Rank cut-in and Gift results that reach Max Rank. Leave blank to use the built-in text.

unlock.name: Unlock Message
unlock.hint: Main message for this theme's Unlock cut-in. Leave blank to use the built-in text.

sync.title: Shared Relationship
sync.heading: Relationship Synchronization
sync.modeContentHint: Names, descriptions, types, artwork, and display settings update together. Rank and progress remain separate for each Actor.
sync.modePartyHint: Shared details, rank, and progress are managed as one party-wide record. When switching to this mode, the currently opened Actor's rank becomes the shared starting point.
sync.recordOptionsHint: Turning an option on replaces that record on linked Actors with the currently opened relationship's copy. Turning it off keeps the last synchronized copy, and future edits stay local.
sync.shareNotesHint: Only notes visible to players update together; GM-only notes always stay local to each Actor. The currently opened relationship supplies the shared starting notes.
sync.shareEventsHint: Manage Event Log entries as one shared record. The currently opened relationship supplies the shared starting events.

sync.statusLocalHint: This record belongs only to the current Actor.
sync.statusLinkedHint: Shared changes are propagated to every linked Actor.
sync.appliedWithSkips: Synchronization applied to {count} Actors; {skipped} could not be linked.
sync.partialFailure: Some Actor records could not be synchronized. Review the selection and try again.
sync.detached: Relationship detached. Its current values were kept.

field.portraitPresentationHint: Choose the presentation directly, regardless of file format. The choice applies to the main view and rank cut-ins.
field.rankCutinHint: Choose separate images for each cut-in state, then adjust the shared framing inside the frozen preview. Blank image fields reuse the portrait image.

field.eventRevealAtRankHint: 0 = always visible. A positive value keeps this entry off the relationship screen until that rank; GMs can still manage it here.
